021import net.tnemc.core.currency.calculations.ItemCalculations;
022import net.tnemc.core.currency.item.ItemCurrency;
023import net.tnemc.item.AbstractItemStack;
024import net.tnemc.plugincore.PluginCore;
025import net.tnemc.plugincore.core.compatibility.log.DebugLevel;
026import org.bukkit.Material;
027import org.bukkit.block.BlockState;
028import org.bukkit.block.Container;
029import org.bukkit.inventory.Inventory;
030import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
031import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.BlockStateMeta;
032import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.ItemMeta;
033
034import java.util.ArrayList;
035import java.util.Collection;
036import java.util.Map;
037import java.util.Locale;
038
039/**
040 * BukkitItemCalculations
041 *
042 * @author creatorfromhell
043 * @since 0.1.2.0
044 */
045public class BukkitItemCalculations extends ItemCalculations<Inventory> {
046
047  @Override
048  public Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> tryInsertIntoContainers(final Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> left,
049                                                                        final Inventory inventory,
050                                                                        final ItemCurrency currency) {
051
052    if(left.isEmpty() || !currency.shulker()) {
053      PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker insert skip early. leftEmpty=" + left.isEmpty()
054                               + " shulkerEnabled=" + currency.shulker(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
055      return left;
056    }
057
058    PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker insert start. inventoryType=" + inventory.getType()
059                             + " inventorySize=" + inventory.getSize()
060                             + " stackCount=" + left.size(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
061
062    final Collection<AbstractItemStack<Object>> remaining = new ArrayList<>();
063
064    for(final AbstractItemStack<Object> abstractStack : left) {
065
066      final ItemStack insertion = resolveInsertionStack(abstractStack);
067      if(insertion == null) {
068        PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker insert skip - unknown material: " + abstractStack.material(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
069        remaining.add(abstractStack);
070        continue;
071      }
072
073      PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker insert processing stack. material=" + insertion.getType().name()
074                               + " amount=" + abstractStack.amount()
075                               + " hasMeta=" + insertion.hasItemMeta(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
076
077      final int originalAmount = abstractStack.amount();
078      final ContainerInsertion result = insertIntoShulkers(inventory, insertion, abstractStack.amount());
079      final int amountLeft = result.amountLeft();
080
081      if(amountLeft > 0) {
082        if(!result.sawShulker()) {
083          PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker insert found no shulker boxes in target inventory.", DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
084        } else {
085          PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker insert left amount after scan: " + amountLeft
086                                   + " material: " + insertion.getType().name()
087                                   + " shulkerCount=" + result.shulkerCount(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
088        }
089        remaining.add(abstractStack.amount(amountLeft));
090      } else {
091        PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker insert success amount=" + originalAmount
092                                 + " material=" + insertion.getType().name()
093                                 + " shulkerCount=" + result.shulkerCount(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
094      }
095    }
096
097    PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker insert done. remainingStacks=" + remaining.size()
098                             + " remainingAmount=" + remaining.stream().mapToInt(AbstractItemStack::amount).sum(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
099
100    return remaining;
101  }
102
103  private ContainerInsertion insertIntoShulkers(final Inventory inventory, final ItemStack insertion,
104                                                final int amount) {
105
106    int amountLeft = amount;
107    boolean sawShulker = false;
108    int shulkerCount = 0;
109    final ItemStack[] contents = inventory.getContents();
110
111    for(int slot = 0; slot < contents.length && amountLeft > 0; slot++) {
112      final ItemStack containerStack = contents[slot];
113      if(containerStack == null || !isShulkerBox(containerStack.getType())) {
114        continue;
115      }
116      sawShulker = true;
117      shulkerCount++;
118      amountLeft = insertIntoContainer(inventory, containerStack, slot, insertion, amountLeft);
119    }
120    return new ContainerInsertion(amountLeft, sawShulker, shulkerCount);
121  }
122
123  private int insertIntoContainer(final Inventory inventory, final ItemStack containerStack, final int slot,
124                                  final ItemStack insertion, final int amountLeft) {
125
126    final ItemMeta itemMeta = containerStack.getItemMeta();
127    if(!(itemMeta instanceof final BlockStateMeta blockStateMeta)) {
128      return amountLeft;
129    }
130
131    final BlockState blockState = blockStateMeta.getBlockState();
132    if(!(blockState instanceof final Container container)) {
133      PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker insert slot=" + slot
134                             + " has BlockStateMeta but not a Container state.", DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
135      return amountLeft;
136    }
137
138    PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker insert attempting slot=" + slot
139                           + " shulkerInvSize=" + container.getInventory().getSize()
140                           + " amountLeftBefore=" + amountLeft, DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
141    final int remaining = addToInventory(container.getInventory(), insertion, amountLeft);
142    PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker insert completed slot=" + slot
143                           + " amountLeftAfter=" + remaining, DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
144
145    blockStateMeta.setBlockState(blockState);
146    containerStack.setItemMeta(blockStateMeta);
147    inventory.setItem(slot, containerStack);
148    return remaining;
149  }
150
151  private Material resolveMaterial(final String materialName) {
152
153    final Material direct = Material.matchMaterial(materialName);
154    if(direct != null) {
155      return direct;
156    }
157
158    final int namespace = materialName.indexOf(':');
159    final String normalized = (namespace > -1)? materialName.substring(namespace + 1) : materialName;
160
161    return Material.matchMaterial(normalized.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
162  }
163
164  private boolean isShulkerBox(final Material material) {
165
166    return material == Material.SHULKER_BOX || material.name().endsWith("_SHULKER_BOX");
167  }
168
169  private ItemStack resolveInsertionStack(final AbstractItemStack<Object> stack) {
170
171    final Object cached = stack.cacheLocale();
172    if(cached instanceof final ItemStack cachedStack) {
173      final ItemStack copy = cachedStack.clone();
174      copy.setAmount(1);
175      return copy;
176    }
177
178    final Material material = resolveMaterial(stack.material());
179    if(material == null) {
180      return null;
181    }
182    return new ItemStack(material, 1);
183  }
184
185  private int addToInventory(final Inventory inventory, final ItemStack insertion, final int amount) {
186
187    int amountLeft = amount;
188    int pass = 0;
189
190    PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker internal add start. material=" + insertion.getType().name()
191                             + " amount=" + amount
192                             + " invType=" + inventory.getType()
193                             + " invSize=" + inventory.getSize(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
194
195    while(amountLeft > 0) {
196      pass++;
197
198      final int toTry = Math.min(insertion.getMaxStackSize(), amountLeft);
199      final ItemStack toInsert = insertion.clone();
200      toInsert.setAmount(toTry);
201
202      final Map<Integer, ItemStack> overflow = inventory.addItem(toInsert);
203      if(overflow.isEmpty()) {
204        PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker internal add pass=" + pass + " inserted=" + toTry + " overflow=0", DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
205        amountLeft -= toTry;
206        continue;
207      }
208
209      final int leftInOverflow = overflow.values().stream().mapToInt(ItemStack::getAmount).sum();
210      final int inserted = toTry - leftInOverflow;
211      PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker internal add pass=" + pass
212                               + " tried=" + toTry
213                               + " inserted=" + inserted
214                               + " overflowAmount=" + leftInOverflow
215                               + " overflowSlots=" + overflow.keySet(), DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
216      if(inserted <= 0) {
217        break;
218      }
219      amountLeft -= inserted;
220    }
221
222    PluginCore.log().debug("Shulker internal add complete. left=" + amountLeft, DebugLevel.DEVELOPER);
223
224    return amountLeft;
225  }
226
227  private record ContainerInsertion(int amountLeft, boolean sawShulker, int shulkerCount) { }
228}
